newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline strengthens, high octane supply tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline strengthens, high octane supply tight.

text.p: NWE spot gasoline prices continued to strengthen with tight high octane supplies drawing active barge buying while a narrow arbitrage and thin European demand continued to dampen cargo activity, traders said.

"It (the arbitrage) is not a window that's working brilliantly at the moment, but with the tight high octane situation at the moment, I expected people will be happy just to hang on to stocks," one trader said.
Barges were actively traded, with one Rotterdam refiner continuing to feature prominently as a buyer. Eurograde barges traded up $2 at $214.50 for refinery Rotterdam liftings.
